images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Square category cover for MANGA AND COMIC BOOKS. It must instantly read as printed COMICS, not an animation poster. Close-up of an OPEN manga/comic book filling almost the whole square, slightly diagonal on a warm cream desk. Its paper pages contain LARGE unmistakable inked comic PANELS with white gutters, expressive original manga characters in dynamic action, black-and-white screentone in some panels and vivid red turquoise yellow illustration in others. One large panel features a windswept black-haired adventurer with turquoise scarf and red jacket, next panels show a cheerful auburn-haired adventurer and a green countryside; ORIGINAL characters, no recognizable franchise. A second colorful illustrated closed comic book peeks underneath along one edge. Beautiful crisp paper texture, clearly defined panel borders and a couple EMPTY speech balloons, hand-drawn black linework, editorial photograph of richly drawn books. Strong focus on drawings and comic layout, not blank book spines or distant books; clearly readable even at small thumbnail size. Natural bright daylight, no purple/violet wash, no lettering, no logos or watermark. Art and book edges centered, bottom fifth less busy for UI label.
